summary_en: ¥300M upper limit, 130,000 shares (4.2% of shares outstanding), open-market purchase window June 8–October 30, 2026. Purpose: capital efficiency and shareholder returns while maintaining investment in lodging-sector operations, staffing, development, and security.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Matters Relating to Acquisition of Own Shares
translation_en_brief: On June 5, 2026, Temairazu Inc. (TSE Standard, code 2477) resolved by written board resolution to acquire up to 130,000 shares of its own common stock, representing 4.2% of shares outstanding (excluding treasury stock), at an aggregate price not to exceed ¥300 million. Acquisitions are to occur via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the window June 8 through October 30, 2026. The company stated the purpose as enhancing capital efficiency and enriching shareholder returns. The board emphasized that concurrent investment in growth will continue, including organizational strengthening for lodging-sector operations, development for functional enhancement and security infrastructure, new-customer acquisition in existing business lines, and new-business creation targeting medium- to long-term growth.
